title: Reverse Singly Linked List - Solution
intuition: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list. Node is object with val and next attributes.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
code:
def solution(head):
    prev = None
    curr = head
    while curr:
        nxt = curr.next
        curr.next = prev
        prev = curr
        curr = nxt
    return prev
common_mistakes: Maintain pointers to prev, curr, and next node.
